reviewType: read-only cross-check of root-authored effects, maintenance and frontend; no tests executed by reviewer

findings.problem: Initial stockNotice guard omitted recycleVisible. A live stock frame for a listed product or productId0 entered fetch, which clears recycleProduct and closes even a busy recycle dialog; the late DELETE result is then ignored by the unmounted dialog scope.
findings.recommendation: Guard recycleVisible alongside stockVisible/moderationVisible and retain the busy dialog during stock pushes.
findings.status: root corrected; readback at line408 now includes recycleVisible; rendered regression execution belongs to root validation receipts

sourceSemanticsChecked.globalTags: Two complete PHP tag domains, not only affected product IDs: product/SKU caches for all products, direct children, unrelated products and activity types.
sourceSemanticsChecked.physicalPrefix: Think TagSet.append stores already-prefixed physical data-key members. Redis set keys get REDIS_PREFIX once around CACHE_TAG_PREFIX+'CRMEB:'+md5(tag). ProductRecycleEffects key hashes/prefixes match the actual PHP Driver/Redis/Tag sources.
sourceSemanticsChecked.luaOrdering: TYPE/SCARD both sets and combined10000 bound precede SMEMBERS; all member prefix/2048-byte checks precede ANY DEL. Keys delete in256-member batches, then both tag sets. No KEYS, SCAN or flush. Invalid second set/member fails before deleting a valid first set.
sourceSemanticsChecked.declaredDifferences: Current cache binding must refer to the retired PHP Redis domain. Missing binding, unknown type/member or oversized set fails retryably. Encoded AutoConfig get.config effects remain unproved and no inventory/withdrawal WS is invented.

durabilityChecked.identity: Dedicated product.recycle.effects payload has exact productId/auditId/sorted affectedProductIds; delivery binds product aggregate, UUID event key and canonical product_recycle DELETE audit with exact three-field action/recycle-or-restore operation before invoking Redis.
durabilityChecked.lease: OrderOutbox generic notification envelope accepts the dedicated event; claim/readback binds PROCESSING lease token plus immutable identity; completion conditions bind current lease and payload. Dedicated effect runs outside inventory business locks. Cache failures remain retryable and duplicate completed messages are skipped.
durabilityChecked.maintenance: External0177 equals embedded0182 SQL. Only known previous CHECK definition is upgraded; current definition is idempotent, unknown drift refuses; checks persistent plain table/RLS/inheritance/event-trigger prerequisites, obtains NOWAIT exclusive maintenance lock, keeps lower timeout budgets, preserves constraint comment and applies10000-row bound. No role/privilege/business updates.

frontendChecked.wire: Canonical guarded DELETE with sole expected_is_del and empty body; validates exact empty-array success. No automatic resend after uncertain outcomes.
frontendChecked.markers: Owner/product/run persistent marker, per-module pending set and cross-tab owner/product Web Lock protect writes; short marker mutex never spans network await. Identity/token/session rechecked after mutex waiting and in Axios transformRequest.
frontendChecked.readRecovery: Catalog read probes outcome lock before GET and captures marker run; callback requires same token/session/current run and returned product. A read begun during another tab's pending write cannot acknowledge that write after it later settles. Acknowledgement separately acquires outcome+marker locks and checks session again.
frontendChecked.componentScope: Dialog captures product/state/context/token/session/epoch; route or owner replacement unmounts and ignores old response. Source consequences are visible: preserve restore visibility, type0 child propagation, type1 waiting-review status, all parent carts invalidated.

validationBoundaries: Static cross-review does not substitute for root serial typecheck, ordinary, native, workerd or rendered/browser checks.

Reviewed effects unit tests spy on redis.eval; they do not execute Lua against a real Redis engine. Actual two-set, invalid-second-member and10000/10001 Lua execution boundaries remain a test-evidence gap at review time, not an observed runtime defect.
Reviewed native maintenance tests cover actual PG16 catalog/comment/idempotence, drift, NOWAIT contention, stricter timeout and row budget; they do not exercise Redis provider networking.
Existing generic getRedis isolate singleton behavior predates this slice; configured physical target/prefix remains an explicit deployment requirement.
